slices.title: Header chrome
slices.intent: The standardized capsule component, the home header rebuild, the hero cleanup, and the site-wide logo toggle application.

symbols.name: HeaderCapsule
symbols.expectation: Renders language, theme, Pro toggle, account slot, gear in that exact order. The account slot renders null through a prop in G. Gear, theme, and language behaviors stay unchanged in function. Pro toggle is the workbench entry affordance, same intent as the hero ProBadge routing, ungated in G.

symbols.name: HomePage
symbols.expectation: Modified: top-left name and tagline from useSiteBranding. Right side renders HeaderCapsule with an empty account slot. Hero logo and tagline removed. GreetingBar no longer rendered. The hero renders the home.headline i18n key gated by showHeadline, with 12-locale parity.

symbols.name: GreetingBar
symbols.expectation: Modified: retired from the home hero, no render site remains.

deficiencies: diff S2 0/6: app/page.tsx::HomePage and app/page.tsx::GreetingBar pin (): JSX.Element but capture () (declarations carry no return annotation). components/header-capsule.tsx::HeaderCapsule, components/workbench/workspace/WorkspaceHome.tsx::WorkspaceHome, components/edit/SlideNavRail/SlideNavRail.tsx::SlideNavRail, components/workbench/workspace/WorkspaceRail.tsx::WorkspaceRail are exists-only rows with no after-signature, yet each captured symbol carries a non-empty signature, so the literal matcher flags every one. Retarget those postconditions to outline truth like the S1 SiteBranding row, or add the missing return annotations.

slices.title: Branding config and public surface
slices.intent: The client-safe branding module, the server-only loader, the public route, and the client hook with safe defaults.

symbols.name: SiteBranding
symbols.expectation: The client-safe model carried by both modules. Shape: { name: string, tagline: string, showLogo: boolean, showHeadline: boolean }.

symbols.name: SITE_BRANDING_DEFAULTS
symbols.expectation: The fallbacks when env and yaml say nothing, kept in the client-safe module. Shape: { name: 'OpenMAIC', tagline: '', showLogo: true, showHeadline: true }.

symbols.name: readBoolean
symbols.expectation: Truthy is 'true' or '1'. Client-safe, no node imports.

symbols.name: loadSiteBranding
symbols.expectation: Server-only: defaults, then server-branding.yml through the module-private loadYamlFile helper, then env. Env wins. SHOW_LOGO and SHOW_HEADLINE parse with readBoolean. Imports node:fs, node:path, and js-yaml.

symbols.name: GET
symbols.expectation: Imports the server module, returns { name, tagline, showLogo, showHeadline } publicly, no PII, no auth, Node runtime. The outline reports () and the implementer adds the : Promise<Response> annotation.

symbols.name: useSiteBranding
symbols.expectation: Returns defaults first, then the fetched values. Imports the client-safe module only.

deficiencies: diff S1 5/6: app/api/site-branding/route.ts::GET after-signature pins (): Promise<Response> but the fresh capture is (); the GET declaration has no explicit : Promise<Response> return annotation. The other five rows match, including the SiteBranding interface retarget.
